audio.strategy: Bundled recorded piano samples routed through one shared Web Audio graph with per-layer buses, connected representative effects, a master bus, limiter, and labeled live-synthesis fallback.

generatedSources.name: Fallback synth piano
generatedSources.method: Triangle oscillator voices with exponential attack and release envelopes; used only when recorded assets cannot be decoded or Web Audio is unavailable.

generatedSources.name: Reverb impulse response
generatedSources.method: Generated exponentially decaying noise AudioBuffer used by ConvolverNode; this is an effect buffer, not a piano recording.

sampleSources.name: VSO2 piano recordings distributed by Tone.js Instruments
sampleSources.notes: Seven recorded A-root samples provide broad root coverage. The source is a single recorded velocity layer; velocity is shaped through gain, compression, touch curves, and timbre rather than being represented as multiple recorded layers.

notes: The Phase 3 graph creates one AudioContext, reusable Piano A/B source buses, ordered Mod 1 → Mod 2 → Delay → Amp/EQ → Compressor → Reverb → Rotary chains, a master bus, a limiter, and one destination.
Program state, effects state, split/zone state, scenes, and morph assignments are serializable. Organ and Synth remain visual-only until Phase 4.
Normal playback loads only bundled files and does not depend on a network request after build.
